note: Names language models are documented to overuse. strong = measured in a study or a counted run. reported = named in a complaint or one person's blocklist, no counts. Use: reject exact matches and the look-alike patterns, for family and given parts, ignoring case and accents. 'reported' is a selection of real-sounding names from G, H and I, not all of G's long fantasy list.

not_confirmed.Sterling: on Aster's recollection; no source I found documents it
not_confirmed.Reyes: only as the double surname Okonkwo-Reyes in D, 2 runs of 10
not_confirmed.Zhou: not on any list I found
